title: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.30524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates give state-space guarantees of stability and safety, but synthesizing and verifying them---especially for nonlinear, high-dimensional systems---remains an open challenge. Existing pipelines verify candidates with numerical solvers (sum-of-squares programs), interval methods, or satisfiability-modulo-theories (SMT) solvers, which often require relaxations, are conservative, or scale poorly with model dimension and nonlinearity. These limitations have also shaped benchmark design: standard test suites are dominated by low-dimensional polynomial systems chosen to suit what solvers can handle rather than what engineering applications require. We address both sides of this challenge. First, we introduce DynaCertBench, a benchmark of 105 instances: 80 non-redundant systems curated from the literature, extended with high-dimensional and control-constrained variants and new nonlinearly coupled system

translated_title: LLM2Cert：基于SMT/Lean验证的大语言模型证书合成
translated_abstract: 李雅普诺夫函数和障碍证书能够为系统的稳定性与安全性提供状态空间层面的保证，但如何合成并验证它们——尤其是针对非线性、高维系统——仍然是一个未解决的挑战。现有流程依赖数值求解器（平方和规划）、区间方法或可满足性模理论（SMT）求解器来验证候选证书，这些方法往往需要松弛处理、结果过于保守，或随模型维度和非线性程度的增加而扩展性变差。这些局限性也影响了基准测试的设计：标准测试集主要由低维多项式系统主导，其选取依据是求解器所能处理的问题而非工程应用的实际需求。我们从两个方面应对这一挑战。首先，我们提出DynaCertBench基准，包含105个实例：其中80个非冗余系统精选自文献，并扩展了高维和控制受限的变体以及新的非线性耦合系统……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LLM2Cert框架，利用大语言模型合成李雅普诺夫函数与障碍证书，并通过SMT求解器和Lean定理证明器进行严格的形式化验证，同时发布包含105个实例的DynaCertBench基准以覆盖高维非线性系统。
